messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take metoprolol at the same time each day, exactly as prescribed.
Do not change your dose or stop taking metoprolol without talking to your prescriber first.
Immediate-release metoprolol tartrate tablets should be taken with a meal or immediately after a meal.
Extended-release tablets and capsules are preferred to be taken with or just after a meal.
Food does not have a significant effect on how much metoprolol your body absorbs.
Keep taking metoprolol even if you feel well.
High blood pressure often causes no symptoms.
Extended-release tablets are scored and can be split in half if your prescriber tells you to.
Swallow the whole or half tablet without crushing or chewing it.
Extended-release capsules (Kapspargo Sprinkle) should be swallowed whole.
If you cannot swallow the capsule, you can open it.
You can sprinkle the contents over a teaspoon of soft food.
Examples of soft food include applesauce, pudding, or yogurt.
Swallow the mixture within 60 minutes and do not save any for later.
Triplet: ["high blood pressure", "has characteristic", "often causes no symptoms"]

The relation 'has characteristic' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity has a characteristic or property described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
B. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
C. 'include': The object entity is a type or example of the subject entity.
D. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
E. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
F. None of the above.
